title: P15.10-B: durable canonical wake intake, restart reconciliation and fenced lease/fairness metadata; production RECONCILE_ONLY
description: Integration BASE 88cdf85b99080b5b2da9dda13c9fae5154108c70. Adds versioned canonical input-topic intake, durable cursor/progress/wake segments, restart observation/due reconciliation, anchored scheduler rows, isolated claim/renew/settle/release fencing, retry/backoff and deterministic multi-Objective fairness plus owner-scoped read-only status. Production wiring only runs RECONCILE_ONLY intake/reconcile; it never claims a generation, calls runObjectivePass, CEO/model/planner/controller/executor, creates missions or sends Telegram. driver_ready and consumer_ready remain false and COST_BINDING_UNVERIFIED is unchanged. B01-B15 are covered by executable focused tests plus P15.10-A regression; C controller wiring, monetary reservation/settlement and live autonomous E2E remain deferred. No merge/deploy.
